# CANDIDATE: J_WINNER_FIX

**Type:** trigger_change

## Hypothesis

The baseline engine loses on 4/29 and 5/01 J winner days due to delayed entry timing. By tightening the entry trigger to fire earlier on rejection signals (e.g., requiring confluence of level rejection and EMA ribbon flip within the same 3-min bar), we anticipate capturing more of the initial move and converting losses to winners on these days while preserving the 5/04 winner.

## Mechanism

Change the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger logic to require simultaneous level rejection AND EMA ribbon flip (rather than ≥2 of 3) for entry. This increases signal specificity, reducing false entries on choppy days (like 5/05-5/06) and improving timing on strong rejection days. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +100% premium).
